scope: One observed forward/backward VoiceOver edge with independent visual identity review
runtime_target_proposed: 17e / 20A4D87D-A2A6-46BD-A889-C4888CE1E152, only after a fresh Root lease

public_api_limit.XCUIElement_hasFocus_means_only: UI focus; not treated as VoiceOver focus
public_api_limit.snapshot_child_order_means_only: Snapshot structure; not interpreted as reader order
public_api_limit.ring_capture_capability: UNPROVEN_UNTIL_RUNTIME; missing/ambiguous ring cannot qualify identity

preconditions: Fresh explicit Root lease and separate approval for build/runtime, with the selected source and header hashes frozen first
Owner verifies already installed app bytes/source and current foreground paused editor; no install, launch, import, fixture, or production change by this test
Owner retains initial public reader/appearance/orientation settings and a recovery path if the test process terminates
Owner reviews one bounded wrapper and exact result path before execution; no runtime command is prepared here
Portrait, static viewport and stable source cohort; no input synthesizer or other focus-moving actor during the capture
reader_actions: Read original isEnabled; enable only if disabled
S0: currentSpeech then screenshot / immutable public snapshot / screenshot
S1: moveForward once then screenshot / immutable public snapshot / screenshot
S2: moveBackward once then screenshot / immutable public snapshot / screenshot
Restore original isEnabled, including restoration to true; retain operation and restoration errors separately
native_test_pass_meaning: CAPTURE_ONLY; foreground, enabled service, nonempty speech, snapshots/screenshots collected, reader enabled state restored

independent_review.ring_requirement: One complete visible VoiceOver focus outline must be distinguishable from component borders in both retained screenshots of every sample; its geometry is stable across the bracket
independent_review.geometry_matching_rule: Convert screenshot pixels to screen points using retained image metadata and app snapshot frame. All four ring-rectangle edges must be within 8 screen points of exactly one positive-area snapshot node frame. Consider all nodes, including empty identifiers and ancestors. Multiple candidates, missing coordinates, unproven scale/orientation, or nonrectangular/unclear outline means FAIL_NOT_QUALIFIED
independent_review.identifier_requirement: The single geometric candidate must have a nonempty identifier occurring exactly once in the full sample tree; record identifier, type, label, value and frame before checking speech. Utterance text must not choose between candidates
independent_review.speech_requirement: The retained actual service utterance at each sample must describe that independently identified item consistently with its label/state/type. Nonempty or phrase matching alone is insufficient. No exact equality between S0 and S2 utterances is assumed
independent_review.observed_order_requirement: S0 and S2 identify the same stable identifier/type/frame, S1 identifies a different element, and screenshots show unchanged circuit viewport. This witnesses only A forward to B and B backward to A in this run
independent_review.review_receipt_requirement: Reviewer records the ring rectangles in original screenshot pixel coordinates, candidate set, coordinate conversion, matched snapshot path/identifier/frame, speech judgement, artifact hashes and rationale for all three states

failure_policy: Any app/service/snapshot/speech error stops further movements and enters restoration

Native assertion failure, missing evidence, absent or ambiguous ring, inconsistent identity/speech, changed viewport, or missing return edge means FAIL_NOT_QUALIFIED without attribution to app or VoiceOver
FailedToStop or any restoration error remains a failure even if a later getter matches; no automatic retry, tap, fallback, or extra navigation
Timeout, process termination or unverified cleanup keeps the lane reserved for owner recovery; the test cannot promise cleanup after process death
Original focus, opaque reader internals and viewport are not promised restored merely because isEnabled matches
non_claims: expected next element from tree order
local_checks_performed: Independent source review of API identity limitations
Prepared source/contract files only; no compilation or runtime
